newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products firm, gasoline by $5.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm, gasoline by $5.

text.p: NWE oil products opened higher on Tuesday morning, gasoline again leading the way with gains of some $5 a tonne, dealers said.

A eurograde gasoline barge traded at $236 fob Rotterdam after sharp NYMEX unleaded gains late on Monday. Offers then rose to $239 fob Rotterdam. Few traders saw many problems in passing the $240 fob mark.
Heating oil barges were $3/$4 a tonne higher as August IPE gas oil futures strengthened. Prompt and second half August offers held at around IPE August +$1 fob Rotterdam in a quiet market.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded at $95.50 fob Rotterdam for loading August 10-20. Prompt material, still in short supply and subject to loading delays, was offered at $97.
